transparency.rationale: One bounded local read; reviewer sees request, source identity, and uncertainty.

stateModel.retention: Transcript and source receipt retained seven days by local policy; delete on request.
stateModel.restoreForkPolicy: No effect replay; restore resumes only a new read request.
stateModel.rationale: One-shot read has no durable task workflow or cross-session memory.

contextStrategy.rationale: Input is a declared small document; caching is not needed for this fixture.

mcp.rationale: The fixture uses one local reader, not MCP.

secretCustody.rationale: The source is public fixture data.

capabilities.rationale: Only local read capability is declared.

control.rationale: No external or irreversible effect is declared.

execution.receiptPolicy: Retain request and source receipt only.
execution.rationale: The fixture performs no write or outbound request.
